identity.name: Coder-GRPO-3B
identity.summary: A fine-tuned code model optimized with GRPO for code tasks such as writing, refactoring, explaining, and fixing code.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: fine-tuned on glaiveai/glaive-code-assistant with stepwise targets and no reported evaluation of code correctness -> code model may produce plausible but incorrect code/refactorings

possible_risks.description: In AI-assisted decision-making tasks, reliance measures how much a person trusts (and potentially acts on) a model's output. Over-reliance occurs when a person puts too much trust in a model, accepting a model's output when the model's output is likely incorrect. Under-reliance is the opposite, where the person doesn't trust the model but should.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight code assistant for writing/refactoring/fixing code with no reported correctness or calibration evaluation -> users may over-trust generated code

possible_risks.description: Confidential information might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight code model intended for code tasks may be used on proprietary codebases, and card does not report any prompt sanitization or data handling safeguards

possible_risks.description: Copyrighted information or other intellectual property might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: code tasks such as refactoring/explaining/fixing code may involve copyrighted or licensed source code in prompts, and card reports no IP safeguards

specifications.model_size: 5.7 GiB of safetensors weights (6,171,926,568 bytes) in F16

training_context.adaptations: The model was fine-tuned with GRPO using Unsloth and TRL, targeting high-signal code tasks such as writing, refactoring, explaining, and fixing code.
training_context.training_data: The model was fine-tuned on glaiveai/glaive-code-assistant, which contains code tasks with stepwise targets.
